description: This file defines the implementation of the SetupSource class, which is responsible for setting up a media source element within a GStreamer-based media player context. It includes methods for constructing, destructing, and executing setup actions related to media source attachment.

classes.name: SetupSource
classes.description: A class responsible for setting up a media source element in the GStreamer pipeline, managing context and notifying when sources are attached.

methods.name: SetupSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetupSource object with the given context, player interface, and source element.

methods.name: ~SetupSource
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of SetupSource object lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the setup operation by assigning the source to the context and scheduling the 'all sources attached' event if applicable.
